SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE in the layout of an eAIP ENR 4.4.1 table (HTML text). Invented names and coordinates: not AIP data.
ENR 4.4.1 NAME-CODE DESIGNATORS FOR FRA SIGNIFICANT POINTS
Legend for FRA relevance: (E) = Horizontal Entry point, (X) = Horizontal Exit point, (I) = Intermediate point, (A) = Arrival Connecting point, (D) = Departure Connecting point.
Name-code designator Coordinates ATS route or other route FRA relevance Remarks/Usage
1 2 3 4 5
TSTAA 010100N 0010100E Nil (I) Nil
TSTAB 010200N 0010200E Nil (I) FL245-FL660 Nil (X) 9500 FT AMSL-FL245 EVEN FLs for all exiting aircraft
TSTAC 010300N 0010300E Nil (I) FL245-FL660 Nil (E) 9500 FT AMSL-FL245 ODD FLs for all entering aircraft
TSTAD 010400N 0010400E Nil Nil ZZAA TIZ1/RMZ1 ENTRY/EXIT point
TSTAE 010500N 0010500E Nil (ID) (D): ZZAB See AIP Testland
TSTAF 010600N 0010600E Nil (EX) EVEN FLs for all entering aircraft, ODD FLs for all exiting aircraft
TSTAG 010700N 0010700E Nil (D) Final point of the SID procedure for ZZAC, (D): ZZAC
TSTAH 010800N 0010800E Nil (I) FL105-FL660 Nil (X) 9500 FT AMSL-FL105 Nil
TSTAI 010900N 0010900E Nil (I) FL205-FL660 (EXD) 9500 FT AMSL-FL205 Mandatory waypoint for DEP ZZAA, EVEN FLs for all entering aircraft, ODD FLs for all exiting aircraft, (D): ZZAA (D): ZZAD See AIP Testland
TSTAJ 011000N 0011000E Nil (I) FL175-FL660 Nil (E) 9500 FT AMSL-FL175 EVEN FLs for all entering aircraft
TSTAK 011100N 0011100E Nil (I) FL205-FL660 (EXAD) 9500 FT AMSL-FL205 ODD FLs for all entering aircraft, EVEN FLs for all exiting aircraft, (A): ZZAA (D): ZZAE See AIP Testland
TSTAL 011200N 0011200E Nil (I) FL105-FL660 Nil (EX) 9500 FT AMSL-FL105
TSTAM 011300N 0011300E Nil (EXA) Mandatory waypoint for ARR ZZAA, EVEN FLs for all entering aircraft, ODD FLs for all exiting aircraft, (A): ZZAA
